extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x) = x^n, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative f'(x) measures instantaneous rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation of finding a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function built from powers of x with constant coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form a^x, especially e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x) when c is constant.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(e^x) = e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(a^x) = a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number satisfying lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The logarithm base e, appearing in d/dx(a^x) = a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A value approached by an expression, used to define e and derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose derivative exists.

extracted_concepts.name: Real Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent n that is any real number, as in x^n.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of position: v(t) = s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Position
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function s(t) describing location over time.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of velocity: a(t) = v'(t) = s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the derivative, written s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the cost function: MC = C'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function C(x) giving cost as a function of quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A quantity describing how one variable changes relative to another.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and antidifferentiation.
